2607.14932.title: Benchmarking Face Recognition without Real Faces
2607.14932.paper_summary: Synthetic face datasets have become effective enough to train face recognition models with accuracy rivaling that of models trained on real photographs. This progress sidesteps the ethical and legal burdens of collecting real biometric data, yet evaluation has not kept pace. Even studies that train entirely on synthetic images still rely on real-face benchmarks to measure performance, leaving the privacy problem only half solved. We ask whether synthetic datasets can replace real benchmarks for face recognition evaluation. We test 12 synthetic datasets against 7 established real benchmarks using 24 pre-trained models that span both convolutional and transformer architectures. Our evaluation covers biometric verification metrics, similarity score distributions, cross-model ranking consistency, and the underlying distributional properties of each dataset. Benchmarking fidelity varies widely across the synthetic candidates, but the two strongest, MorphFace and Vec2Face, reproduce the relative behavior of real benchmarks and reach agreement levels that fall within the natural disagreement already observed among the real benchmarks themselves. These results establish that well-constructed synthetic datasets can support reliable comparative evaluation for face recognition, moving the field closer to a fully synthetic and privacy-preserving pipeline for both training and benchmarking.
2607.14932.paper_summary_zh: 合成臉部數據集已經足夠有效，可以訓練出與基於真實照片訓練的模型相媲美的臉部識別模型準確性。這一進展迴避了收集真實生物識別數據的倫理和法律負擔，但評估卻未能跟上進展。即使是完全基於合成圖像進行訓練的研究，仍然依賴於真實臉部基準來衡量性能，這使得隱私問題僅得到了一半的解決。我們詢問合成數據集是否能取代真實基準來進行臉部識別評估。我們使用24個涵蓋卷積和Transformer架構的預訓練模型，對12個合成數據集與7個既有的真實基準進行測試。我們的評估涵蓋生物識別驗證指標、相似度分數分佈、跨模型排名一致性以及每個數據集的基本分佈特性。基準的忠實度在合成候選者之間差異很大，但兩個最強的，MorphFace和Vec2Face，重現了真實基準的相對行為，並達到了在真實基準之間已觀察到的自然分歧範圍內的協議水平。這些結果確立了良好構建的合成數據集可以支持可靠的比較評估，將臉部識別領域推向一個完全合成且保護隱私的訓練和基準流程。
